draft.heroMessage: Your Local Asheville & Black Mountain Real Estate Experts
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Freestone Properties—where personalized service and deep local insight meet innovative real estate solutions in the heart of Western North Carolina.
draft.tagline: A Boutique Real Estate Experience with a Hometown Touch.
draft.aboutParagraph: Freestone Properties is proud to be a truly local real estate firm serving Asheville, Black Mountain, and the surrounding mountain communities. Founded by Scott and Lisa Russell with a vision to bring a blend of personal passion and professional expertise to real estate, our small, innovative team ensures every client receives hands-on guidance. In 2024, we forged a partnership with Allen Tate/Beverly-Hanks, combining the resources of the Carolinas' largest real estate company with our boutique, family-owned approach. Whether you’re selling a beloved home or searching for your mountain escape, we offer experience, technology, and real market insight—always with the personal service you deserve.
draft.conciergeLine: Thinking about making a move in Asheville or Black Mountain? Connect with our team for an honest conversation about your real estate goals.
draft.contactLine: Call (828) 419-0444 or email realestate@freestoneproperties.com to get started with Freestone Properties today.
draft.tone: friendly, knowledgeable, trustworthy, and hyper-local—blending professional experience with a personal, welcoming touch
